text.en: This Order may be cited as the Passports Act (Amendment) Order, 2021 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st September 2015.
Section 3[1A) of the Passports Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is amended by deleting "3" and by substituting "5" therefor. Amendment of Schedule

The Schedule to the Act is amended, in the Appendix, in relation to the item on "Multiple entry for ABTC holder" which appears in the first column, by deleting "3" and by substituting "5" therefor. Made this 12th. day of Safar, 1443 Hijriah corresponding to the 19th. day of September, 2021 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
